title: Kotoba Colosseum polish
changes: Integrated Kotoba Colosseum into the normal Activity Village card/grid presentation and made its village marker match the existing map style more closely.
Removed the solid black sprite backgrounds from party members and battle monsters while preserving the pixel-art characters.
After answering, the normal feedback and Next Turn box now replaces the answer choices in place so no downward scrolling is needed.
Returning to Activity Village now always stops and resets the Colosseum background music.
Bumped all release-controlled files and caches to v11.3.3.
